healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate Mixpanel service account access for the configured project.

cohorts.list.title: List Saved Cohorts
cohorts.list.description: List saved cohorts for the configured Mixpanel project.

funnels.list.title: List Saved Funnels
funnels.list.description: List saved funnels for the configured Mixpanel project.

funnel.query.title: Query Funnel
funnel.query.description: Query a saved Mixpanel funnel over a bounded date range.

insights.query.title: Query Insights
insights.query.description: Query a saved Mixpanel Insights report by bookmark id.

retention.query.title: Query Retention
retention.query.description: Query Mixpanel retention (cohort analysis) over a date range.

segmentation.query.title: Query Segmentation
segmentation.query.description: Query Mixpanel segmentation for a single event over a date range.

events.query.title: Query Events
events.query.description: Query Mixpanel event counts over a date range.

event.description: JSON array of event names, as Mixpanel expects.

events.top.title: Top Events
events.top.description: List the most common Mixpanel events in the project.

events.names.title: Event Names
events.names.description: List Mixpanel event names in the project.

eventProperties.top.title: Top Event Properties
eventProperties.top.description: List the most common properties for a Mixpanel event.

eventProperties.values.title: Event Property Values
eventProperties.values.description: List top values for a Mixpanel event property.

profiles.query.title: Query Profiles
profiles.query.description: Query Mixpanel user (or group) profiles that match a selector.

annotations.list.title: List Annotations
annotations.list.description: List Mixpanel chart annotations in a date range.

annotations.delete.title: Delete Annotation
annotations.delete.description: Delete a Mixpanel chart annotation by id.

activity.stream.title: Activity Stream
activity.stream.description: Return a Mixpanel user's recent event stream.

jql.query.title: Run JQL
jql.query.description: Run a Mixpanel JQL script against the project.

events.import.title: Import Events
events.import.description: Import Mixpanel events through the ingestion API.

events.description: Event objects with event and properties.

profiles.update.title: Update Profiles
profiles.update.description: Create or update Mixpanel people profiles through the engage API.

updates.description: Engage update objects ($set, $distinct_id, $token or project auth).

groups.delete.title: Delete Group
groups.delete.description: Permanently delete a Mixpanel group profile via the ingestion /groups API with verbose=1. Covers MIXPANEL_DELETE_GROUP.

token.description: Mixpanel project token that authorizes the ingestion call.

group_key.description: Group category/type identifier (for example Company, Organization, Team).

group_id.description: Unique identifier of the specific group profile.

groups.batchUpdate.title: Batch Update Group Profiles
groups.batchUpdate.description: Send a batch of Mixpanel group profile updates as a JSON list of update objects via the ingestion /groups API with verbose=1. Covers MIXPANEL_GROUP_BATCH_UPDATE.

updates.description: Group update objects, each with $token, $group_key, $group_id, and an operation ($set, $set_once, $union, $remove, $unset, or $delete).

groups.deleteProperty.title: Delete Group Properties
groups.deleteProperty.description: Permanently remove properties from a Mixpanel group profile with the $unset operation via the ingestion /groups API with verbose=1. Covers MIXPANEL_GROUP_DELETE_PROPERTY.

token.description: Mixpanel project token that authorizes the ingestion call.

group_key.description: Group category/type identifier (for example Company, Organization, Team).

group_id.description: Unique identifier of the specific group profile.

properties.description: Property names to unset from the group profile.

groups.removeFromList.title: Remove from Group List Property
groups.removeFromList.description: Remove values from list properties on a Mixpanel group profile with the $remove operation via the ingestion /groups API with verbose=1. Covers MIXPANEL_REMOVE_FROM_GROUP_LIST_PROPERTY.

token.description: Mixpanel project token that authorizes the ingestion call.

group_key.description: Group category/type identifier (for example Company, Organization, Team).

group_id.description: Unique identifier of the specific group profile.

remove.description: Object mapping list property names to the value(s) to remove.

groups.setOnce.title: Set Group Property Once
groups.setOnce.description: Set Mixpanel group profile properties only if they are not already set, using the $set_once operation via the ingestion /groups API with verbose=1. Covers MIXPANEL_SET_GROUP_PROPERTY_ONCE.

token.description: Mixpanel project token that authorizes the ingestion call.

group_key.description: Group category/type identifier (for example Company, Organization, Team).

group_id.description: Unique identifier of the specific group profile.

properties.description: Key-value pairs to set only when the property is absent.

groups.union.title: Update Group List Property
groups.union.description: Add unique values to list properties on a Mixpanel group profile with the $union operation via the ingestion /groups API with verbose=1. Covers MIXPANEL_UPDATE_GROUP_LIST_PROPERTY.

token.description: Mixpanel project token that authorizes the ingestion call.

group_key.description: Group category/type identifier (for example Company, Organization, Team).

group_id.description: Unique identifier of the specific group profile.

properties.description: Object mapping list property names to the array of values to union.

identity.create.title: Create Identity
identity.create.description: Link an anonymous Mixpanel ID with an identified user ID through the ingestion /track API with verbose=1. data must be a JSON $identify event object: {"event":"$identify","properties":{"$identified_id":"...","$anon_id":"...","token":"..."}}. Covers MIXPANEL_CREATE_IDENTITY.

data.description: JSON $identify event object with the $identified_id, $anon_id, and token properties.

identity.alias.title: Create Identity Alias
identity.alias.description: Create a Mixpanel alias between two distinct IDs through the ingestion /track API with verbose=1. data must be a JSON $create_alias event object: {"event":"$create_alias","properties":{"distinct_id":"...","alias":"...","token":"..."}}. Covers MIXPANEL_IDENTITY_CREATE_ALIAS.

data.description: JSON $create_alias event object with the distinct_id, alias, and token properties.

serviceAccounts.create.title: Create Service Account
serviceAccounts.create.description: Create a Mixpanel organization service account and optionally add it to projects. The response token is returned once and cannot be recovered. Covers MIXPANEL_CREATE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT.

username.description: Descriptive name for the service account.

expires.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the service account expires.

projects.description: Projects to add the service account to, each with id and role.

serviceAccounts.list.title: List Service Accounts
serviceAccounts.list.description: List every service account in a Mixpanel organization. Covers MIXPANEL_LIST_SERVICE_ACCOUNTS.

projects.list.title: Get All Projects
projects.list.description: Return the authenticated Mixpanel user together with the projects map. Covers MIXPANEL_GET_ALL_PROJECTS.

annotations.tags.create.title: Create Annotation Tag
annotations.tags.create.description: Create a Mixpanel annotation tag by name. Requires a role of at least Analyst. Covers MIXPANEL_CREATE_ANNOTATION_TAG.

name.description: Name of the annotation tag to create.

annotations.tags.list.title: Get Annotation Tags
annotations.tags.list.description: List the Mixpanel annotation tags attached to at least one annotation. Requires a role of at least Analyst. Covers MIXPANEL_GET_ANNOTATION_TAGS_ALT1.

eventProperties.aggregate.title: Aggregated Event Property Values
eventProperties.aggregate.description: Get unique, total, or average data for a single event property over days, weeks, or months. Covers MIXPANEL_AGGREGATED_EVENT_PROPERTY_VALUES.

event.description: Event name (a single event, not an array).

name.description: Property name to get data for.

values.description: Specific property values to include, encoded as a JSON array.

interval.description: Number of units to return data for; use instead of from_date/to_date.

limit.description: Maximum number of values to return.

retention.frequency.title: Query Frequency Report
retention.frequency.description: Get data about how frequently users perform events. Covers MIXPANEL_QUERY_FREQUENCY_REPORT.

unit.description: Overall time period to return frequency of actions for.

addiction_unit.description: Granularity to return frequency of actions at.

event.description: Event to generate returning counts for.

where.description: Expression to filter the returning events by.

on.description: Property expression to segment the second event on.

limit.description: Return the top limit segmentation values.

segmentation.average.title: Numerically Average
segmentation.average.description: Average a numeric expression for events per unit time. Covers MIXPANEL_QUERY_NUMERIC_AVERAGE.

event.description: Event name (a single event, not an array).

on.description: Numeric property expression to evaluate per unit time.

unit.description: Bucket size for the returned data.

segmentation.sum.title: Numerically Sum
segmentation.sum.description: Sum a numeric expression for events per unit time. Covers MIXPANEL_QUERY_NUMERIC_SUM.

event.description: Event name (a single event, not an array).

on.description: Numeric property expression to evaluate per unit time.

unit.description: Bucket size for the returned data.

segmentation.numeric.title: Numerically Bucket
segmentation.numeric.description: Get event data segmented and filtered by properties, with numeric values placed into buckets. Covers MIXPANEL_SEGMENTATION_NUMERIC_QUERY.

event.description: Event name (a single event, not an array).

on.description: Numeric property expression to bucket by.

unit.description: Bucket size for the returned data.

breach.waiver: explicit user policy 2026-09-13 for non-China historical incidents
